title: Regen Loader Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Static attributes of the regen loader subsystem, defining magazine capacity, regen rate, energy cost per round, and ammo supply behavior. Used for energy weapons (lasers, blasters) and arcade-style regenerating weapons (missile cooldown regen). Durability is split into a feed (non-critical) and a magazine (the only critical) module: the magazine reaching zero destroys the whole subsystem and cooks off the stored rounds, while the feed reaching zero only stops further loading. Belt composition (projectile_types) and the belt label (belt_label) are per-instance fields written in the subsystems block of a part JSON; see subsystem/dynamic/regen_loader_dynamic_attr.schema.json. They do not belong in this file.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference path, used for editor intelligent suggestions and validation

basic_durability.description: Subsystem basic durability, distributed to the two modules by their feed / magazine durability_weight. The subsystem durability is the sum of both modules; the magazine reaching zero destroys the whole subsystem, and either module must be repaired to 30% of its own maximum to leave the destroyed state.

pass_damage.description: Whether to pass damage to the subsystem holder. First-party definitions write false: hit damage is absorbed by the feed / magazine modules and never reaches the part or vehicle.

limit_damage.description: Whether to limit damage transfer to remaining durability. e.g. 40 damage, 20 remaining, only 20 transfers.

hidden.description: Whether to hide the subsystem in HUD, commonly used for non-functional parts that only provide damage differentiation.

magazine_capacity.description: Magazine capacity, maximum number of rounds that can be stored.

regen_per_minute.description: Regeneration rate. regenRoundByRound=true: rounds recovered per minute; regenRoundByRound=false: full reload cycles per minute. 0 = no auto-regeneration (static magazine).

regen_round_by_round.description: Regeneration mode. true = round-by-round (regenerates immediately after each round consumed); false = batch reload (replenishes entire magazine when empty).

energy_cost_per_round.description: Energy consumed per round regenerated (Joules). 0 = free regeneration.

reload_time.description: Time to deliver one round to a consumer (in seconds). In regen mode, the delay from round birth to availability.

can_supply_multiple.description: Whether multiple consumers can receive ammo from this loader simultaneously.

regen_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) after delivering a round before regeneration starts. 0 = regen starts immediately (produce while supply).

durability_weight.description: Module durability weight. Module max durability = basic_durability x this weight / the sum of both module weights; must be a finite positive number.

feed.description: Feed module attributes - non-critical, weight defaults to 1.0 when omitted. Reaching zero only stops further loading: stock, belt pointer and rounds already chambered in the launcher are untouched, and the subsystem is not destroyed; the feed works again only after being repaired to 30% of its own maximum durability.

durability_weight.description: Module durability weight. Module max durability = basic_durability x this weight / the sum of both module weights; must be a finite positive number.

magazine.description: Magazine module attributes - the only critical module, weight defaults to 1.0 when omitted. Reaching zero destroys the whole subsystem: the stored rounds cook off once and any in-progress regeneration batch is discarded (pre-paid energy is not refunded); the magazine stores and regenerates again only after being repaired to 30% of its own maximum durability. Set a hitbox module to magazine to charge that hitbox's damage to this module.

on_destroyed.description: Sound event when the subsystem is destroyed.

on_activate.description: Sound event when the subsystem is activated.

on_deactivate.description: Sound event when the subsystem is deactivated.

examples.description: Round-by-round regen example - MG34 machine gun, 150-round magazine, 800 rounds/min, with 0.5s regen delay
Slow regen example - 50mm cannon, 40 rounds, 10 rounds/min, with reload time delay
Module weight example - 30 total durability, feed takes 1/3 (10) and magazine takes 2/3 (20)
